learning_outcomes.text: The aim of the course is to obtain skills in using the numerical computations software used to analyse machines and structures, verification of results computed in the Finite Element Analysis Software, interpretation of the differences between obtained numerical analysis results and the theoretical verification
Improving the skills in using various CAE software used in the mechanical engineering
has knowledge of computer-aided design, manufacturing and operation of mechanical, mechatronic and equipment;
has knowledge of numerical methods used in simulation and analysis of mechanical systems, as well as in the process of their design, manufacturing and operation;
can use analytical, simulation and experimental methods to formulate and solve engineering tasks.
is ready to complete and critically evaluate specialized knowledge and is able to select sources of knowledge and methods of learning appropriate for himself/herself and others;
is willing to comprehensively analyze and effectively carry out assigned tasks, and in the event of difficulties in solving them, use expert opinion;

syllabus_topics: Rules and duties during laboratory tasks and course tests
Presentation of popular finite element analysis software facilities including ANSYS Mechanical and Inventor Nastran
Presentation of geometry modifications, mesh generation and boundary conditions definition
Performing series of laboratory tasks and presentation of new CAE software
Presentation of direct and parametric definition of the geometry
Improved mesh generation techniques and solution of static and dynamic models
Presentation of export and import facilities in the CAE and FEA software
assessment_rules: The condition for passing the course is to achieve all the required learning outcomes specified for the course.
